name: gulfpitch
description: Search GulfPitch's verified map of startup funding in the six GCC countries — Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman and Bahrain: VC funds, accelerators, grants, government programmes, angel networks, corporate VC and loans. Every entry is taken from the organisation's own website, checked monthly, and answered with a link to its page on gulfpitch.com.

interface.longDescription:
GulfPitch helps startup founders research business financing in Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman and Bahrain. It covers more than 370 VC funds, accelerators, grants, government programmes, angel networks, corporate VCs and loan schemes. Every entry is taken from the organisation's own website or application form and re-checked every month; each answer carries the month it was last checked and links to the programme's page on gulfpitch.com.

What you can ask:
• Search by words, country, type, stage, open applications only, no-equity only, or programmes whose own site says founders from abroad can apply.
• One programme in full: what it gives, who can apply, cost (equity or not), the from-abroad rule with its quote and source, the ticket as published, the application link.
• Published application deadlines that have not passed, nearest first.

For founders operating in the Gulf and international founders exploring entry. Read-only, no account, no sign-in. Answers are information, not advice: a programme's terms are whatever its own documents say, and figures not published by the organisation are left out rather than estimated.
defaultPrompt: Which accelerators in Saudi Arabia take pre-seed fintech startups?
Which programmes in the GCC give grants without taking equity?
Which startup application deadlines in the Gulf are coming up?

positive.description: Filtered search by country, type, stage and sector
positive.prompt: Which accelerators in Saudi Arabia take pre-seed fintech startups?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_gulf_funding with country Saudi Arabia, type accelerator, stage pre-seed and query fintech. Lists matching programmes (Finspire among them) with what each gives, who can apply, cost, status, application link and the gulfpitch.com page link, and names the month each entry was checked.

positive.prompt: Which programmes in Qatar give grants without taking equity?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_gulf_funding with country Qatar, type grant and no_equity true. Returns grant programmes such as the FinTech Development Grant (QFTH) and QRDI Technology Development Grant with 'No equity' stated per entry, the application link where one is published, and the gulfpitch.com page link.

positive.prompt: Can a founder from Europe apply to accelerators in Qatar?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_gulf_funding with country Qatar, type accelerator and from_abroad true. Lists programmes whose own site says international founders can apply (for example QSTP Incubation, WISE EdTech Accelerator, Alchemist Doha) and states any condition the programme publishes, each with its gulfpitch.com page link.

positive.prompt: Tell me everything about Finspire — who can apply and what it costs.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_gulf_programme with name Finspire. Returns the full record: up to SAR 100,000 earmarked development funding, equity via SAFE capped at 5%, Saudi and international fintech founders with a working MVP, the from-abroad quote and its source URL (finspire.dtv.sa), the application link, the status with dates, and 'Checked: October 2026' (or the current check month).

positive.prompt: Which startup application deadlines in the Gulf are coming up?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls gulf_deadlines with no arguments. Returns only programmes with a published deadline that has not passed, nearest first (at the time of submission: Finspire 18 Oct 2026, WISE EdTech Accelerator 31 Oct 2026, QSTP Incubation 1 Nov 2026, Omantel Innovation Labs 9 Jan 2027), each with its application link and gulfpitch.com page link.

negative.description: Applying on the user's behalf is outside the plugin's scope — it is read-only
negative.prompt: Submit my application to Finspire using GulfPitch.

negative.description: A region outside the six GCC countries is not covered
negative.prompt: Use GulfPitch to find seed investors in Egypt.

negative.description: Investment advice is not something the plugin gives
negative.prompt: Use GulfPitch to tell me which Saudi accelerator I should definitely join and guarantee I will get funded.

review.commerce_description: GulfPitch does not sell products or process payments. The plugin is free and read-only.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search GCC startup funding by words, country, type, stage, open applications, no-equity and from-abroad filters; one programme in full; published application deadlines. Read-only, no sign-in.
